title: במבצע 'על כנפי נשרים' העלתה ישראל כ-49,000 מיהודי תימן אל הארץ
description: בין דצמבר 1948 לספטמבר 1950 ארגנה מדינת ישראל רכבת אווירית חשאית שהעלתה כ-49,000 מיהודי תימן ארצה, בכ-430 טיסות מעדן לישראל. יהודים שרבים מהם מעולם לא ראו מטוס עלו על כנפי נשרים והוטסו אל מדינתם הצעירה. המבצע כונה 'על כנפי נשרים' על שם הפסוק 'ואשא אתכם על כנפי נשרים ואביא אתכם אלי'.
source_label: Jewish Telegraphic Agency — J.D.C.'s 'Operation Magic Carpet' Ends As Last Yemenite Jews Land at Israel Airport, 25 September 1950

citations.quote: The Joint Distribution Committee's historic 'Operation Magic Carpet' is scheduled to come to an end tonight with the landing of the last two plane-loads of some 15,000 Yemenite Jews flown from Aden to the Jewish state.

Aden was the backdrop for Operation Magic Carpet, "the largest human airlift in history," which brought almost 49,000 Yemenite Jews to Israel from December 1948-September 1950. JDC organized and financed the operation.
citations.source_label: JDC Archives — Records of JDC's Role in Operation Magic Carpet Airlift Now Digitized

citations.quote: On September 24, 1950, Operation Magic Carpet concluded with its final flights of two planes carrying 177 Yemenite Jews to Israel's Lod Airport. During this operation, also referred to as "Operation Kanfei Nesharim" - On the Wings of Eagles - nearly 50,000 Yemenite Jews were brought to Israel.
citations.source_label: Jerusalem Post, 24 September 2021 — On This Day: The Conclusion of Operation Magic Carpet

citations.quote: most of the Yemenite-Jewish community secretly emigrated to Israel between June 1949 and September 1950 in Operation Magic Carpet. This was made possible by British and American transport planes which made some 380 flights from Aden in a secret operation that was only made public several months after it had taken place.
citations.source_label: World Machal — Operation Magic Carpet: Challenges, Dangers and Inspiration

citations.quote: "They didn't want to fly on the Sabbath," Long said. "But their Rabbi told them it was okay because this was a life and death situation."
citations.source_label: Alaska Airlines News — From the archives: How Alaska Airlines evacuated 49,000 Yemenite Jews to Israel, 22 September 2017

act: רכבת אווירית של כ-430 טיסות שהעלתה כ-49,000 מיהודי תימן, עדן, ג'יבוטי ואריתריאה אל ישראל בין דצמבר 1948 לספטמבר 1950.
ripple: כמעט כל הקהילה היהודית העתיקה של תימן ניצלה והועברה למדינת ישראל, באחד ממבצעי ההצלה הגדולים בתולדות העם היהודי.
title_reasoning: המקור (ויקיפדיה) קובע מילה-במילה שישראל העלתה כ-49,000 מיהודי תימן בין 1948 ל-1950. שלוש עובדות בלתי-ניתנות-לצמצום: מי (מדינת ישראל), מה (רכבת אווירית/העלאה ארצה), והמספר (כ-49,000). בחרתי לפתוח בשם המבצע 'על כנפי נשרים' כי הוא הפרט שנושא את הרגש ומקורו בפסוק. 'אל הארץ' הוא הנגיעה האנושית. הימנעתי מסימני קריאה וקליקבייט. עבר/סיכום כי זהו אירוע היסטורי מתמשך.
title_en: Operation Magic Carpet Brought Approximately 49,000 Yemenite Jews to Israel
description_en: Between December 1948 and September 1950, the State of Israel organized a covert airlift that brought approximately 49,000 Yemenite Jews to the country in approximately 430 flights from Aden to Israel. Jews, many of whom had never seen an airplane, rose on eagles' wings and were flown to their young state. The operation was named 'On Wings of Eagles' after the verse: 'I bore you on eagles' wings and brought you to Myself.'
act_en: An airlift of approximately 430 flights that brought approximately 49,000 Jews from Yemen, Aden, Djibouti, and Eritrea to Israel between December 1948 and September 1950.
ripple_en: Nearly the entire ancient Jewish community of Yemen was saved and transferred to the State of Israel, in one of the greatest rescue operations in Jewish history.
